rawText: GRAND CRU CLASSÉ / CHÂTEAU Saint Georges (Côte Pavie) / SAINT-EMILION GRAND CRU / 2012
description: Château Saint Georges-Côte Pavie is a small Saint-Émilion Grand Cru Classé estate located on the Côte Pavie, adjacent to Château Pavie, on limestone-clay slopes typical of the appellation. The blend is dominated by Merlot with Cabernet Franc and a small proportion of Cabernet Sauvignon, aged in oak barrels typical of the region's Grand Cru Classé production.
